decisions.rationale: 'autosomal recessive disease' refers to a family of multiple specific diseases that are inherited in that pattern, matching the guideline's own example of a Disease Class.
'glucose / galactose malabsorption' names one specific defined disease (the condition caused by the SGLT1 missense mutation) with no further categorization, so it is a Specific Disease.

decisions.rationale: 'genetic diseases' is a very general term, similar to 'disease', that does not point to a defined family of specific diseases. Guidelines exclude very general terms, so it is not annotated.
